meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它会将积压的 GitHub issue 按共同的根本原因聚类，为每组创建一个“计划主问题”和设计文档，用统一评论关闭旧子问题；也能将新 bug 归入已有计划，或把一组相关修复打包成一个 PR 并让这些 issue 自动一起关闭。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20+ open issues 且很多像同一缺陷；当你要求做 triage、cluster、dedupe 等整理；当新 bug 需判断归属，或想用一个 PR 集中解决一批相关 issue 时触发。

say.text: 通读所有 open issues 和评论，按共同根源分组并各建一个主问题。
say.note: 它读全文后聚类，给子问题发标准关闭说明。

say.text: 这是一个新 issue，判断该归入哪个现有计划。
say.note: 它会匹配主问题并打上 Round N 标记。

say.text: 把这批 issue 的修复做成一个 PR，一次全部关闭。
say.note: 会用 Closes #N 列出子问题，附上测试矩阵。

howto.what_en: Given many GitHub issues, Claude reads full texts, groups by root cause, opens a plan-master plus plan doc per cluster, closes child issues with a redirect comment, routes new bugs into existing plans, and can ship one PR that closes a whole cluster.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like shared defects; when you ask for triage/cluster/dedupe or similar clean-up; or when you need to route a new bug or ship one PR fixing a batch.

say_en.text: Group all open issues by root cause and create one plan master per group.
say_en.note: Closes old children after reading full text.

say_en.text: Here's a new issue. Which existing plan should it go to?
say_en.note: Matches masters and logs a Round-N entry.

say_en.text: Turn these issues into one fix PR that closes them all.
say_en.note: Creates PR body with Closes #N and the test matrix.
